# Practical AI

Practical AI provides corporate AI training for business teams. Programs are built around real team workflows, approved tools, practical exercises and human review. Founder: Danil Usik, based in Valencia, Spain.

## Official pages

- [Corporate AI training](https://practical-ai.pro/): service overview and ways to start.
- [AI training for HR and L&D](https://practical-ai.pro/for-hr/): how to frame a useful first program.
- [Programs](https://practical-ai.pro/programs/): one-day team lab, one-week AI workflow sprint and four-week team practice.
- [Danil Usik](https://practical-ai.pro/about/): founder and working approach.
- [Guides](https://practical-ai.pro/blog/): practical articles for business teams.
